This page shows everything, including exact locations. It exists so you can search for one specific collectible and find it. If you are playing blind, use the interactive spoiler-free version instead — it hides locations until you ask for them, one item at a time.

Live Client and Character Foundation

You are here when: The Windows title screen, character menu, perk screen, and current season panel.

Snapshot date: 2026-08-06. Public Test Server content is excluded until it reaches the live client.

Confirm current live-client state

Live-state check

HintCheck the title screen and news panel before starting a completion session.
WhereUse the Windows client at update 1.7.25.39 or later, with Infestations and Burning Springs installed.
Full detailRecord the client version, active season, server type, character level, subscription state, and owned account entitlements. Re-audit this pack after any content update because live availability can change without a new character.

Reach level 50 before claiming leveled unique rewards (missable)

Progression gate

HintExplore, join public activities, and complete repeatable content before cashing in rare one-time rewards.
WhereRaise the selected completion character to level 50 before finishing quests that award level-scaled unique gear.
Full detailUse repeatable events, exploration, Daily Ops, and ordinary quests to reach level 50. Only then complete one-time reward quests so their unique items arrive at maximum level; an online character cannot reload an earlier manual save.

Complete character and legendary-perk progression

Progression gate

HintKeep leveling after the ordinary perk slots are established.
WhereUnlock every legendary-perk slot and finish the chosen account-wide perk-card catalogue.
Full detailReach each legendary slot milestone, collect and rank the selected legendary perks with perk coins, acquire every ordinary perk card and animated variant that remains obtainable, and preserve spare loadouts for crafting, combat, exploration, and team play.

Complete human and playable-ghoul routes (missable)

Character route

HintTreat the transformation as a separate character route because faction access changes.
WhereFinish every human-only faction requirement before transforming, then complete the ghoul introduction and ghoul progression on a preserved character plan.
Full detailUse one character to clear all disguise-sensitive and human-gated faction work first. Complete the ghoul transformation route on that character or a second one, rank every ghoul perk and Glow system unlock, and verify both route-specific records without assuming one state can access every interaction.

Camp system

Fishing and Aquatic Collections

You are here when: Fisherman's Rest, regional fishing waters, bait crafting, and the monthly live rotation.

Monthly axolotls are real-time gated and must be audited against the active service calendar.

Complete the fishing introduction

Fishing progression

HintFollow the new radio signal to the anglers' settlement.
WhereStart the fishing quest at Fisherman's Rest and unlock the rod, bait, and fishing interface.
Full detailFinish the full introduction, craft or equip a rod, learn bait production, catch and turn in the requested fish, and confirm fishing dailies and improved-bait rewards are active.

Catch every permanent fish and size class

Fishing collection

HintTry distinct waters, weather, bait, and times rather than repeating one spot.
WhereFill every permanent fish entry and its available size records in the fishing catalogue.
Full detailUse the required regional water and bait for each species, land the fish without breaking the line, and record every common, uncommon, rare, local-legend, and large-size entry. Preserve special bait for conditions that require it.

Catch every monthly axolotl when available (missable)

Rotating fish

HintCheck the live monthly notice before choosing a fishing region.
WhereCatch the currently active monthly axolotl during its announced calendar window.
Full detailUse the month's required water and bait, land the axolotl before the rollover, and record it. Missed months are not normally recoverable until Bethesda repeats their schedule, so they remain time-gated rather than ordinary requirements.

Nuclear, Bounty, Infestation, and Account Completion
